audit_name: Canario D3 v3 targeted post-repair audit
scope_constraint: Targeted regression only. No broad semantic audit performed.

rows.finding: Continuation supplies Municipalidad de Esparza, CCDRE, procurement-procedure scope, and execution phase required by the canonical assertion.
Article 3 intro establishes that Proveeduría need not process listed items in the SDU; post-boundary continuation completes the caja-chica legal references to LGCP/RLGCP.
Post-boundary continuation expressly supplies Tesorería, the next-business-day deadline after vale liquidation, and SDU entry of the caja-chica purchase information.
The pre-boundary target is a complete sentence covering participating units, Proveeduría, start-to-finish scope, and competence limitation; no omitted continuation is needed.
Continuation completes the community referent as the community where the project will be developed, making the quality/communication assertion self-sufficient.
Continuation expressly lists object, start/end timing, cost, contractor, inspection personnel, and communication medium with the promoting entity.
The complete Article 17 target before the marker directly supports PI management of convenio-marco/entrega-según-demanda tenders and case-by-case selection for ME/CCDRE.
The same complete pre-boundary Article 17 target expressly states approval under the internal regulation, LGCP, and RLGCP.
The pre-boundary Article 17 target expressly places convenio-marco processing with PI before DCPMH under LGCP, RLGCP, and the regulation.
Article 21 intro attributes the duty to Proveeduría and item t) fully states SDU publication of invitations for all procurement procedures before the marker.
Article 21 intro plus complete item hh) before the marker directly supports the condition and requirement for proof of additional budget content.
The same complete pre-boundary item hh) expressly requires reasons for the budget difference to be incorporated into the award recommendation.
Article 23 intro attributes the function to CRAO and complete item d) states review/approval of final resource-resolution recommendations under the RLGCP procedure.
Before the marker the target fully states that CRAO members must process all preceding recommendations in the SDU.
Article 27 intro plus the first complete sentence of item n) fully supports the contract-modification request duty under LGCP/RLGCP; the truncated next sentence concerns a separate 20%-50% condition.
Post-boundary continuation completes the 20%-to-50% modification condition with the required approval of the corresponding immediate superior.
Continuation supplies real-property leasing/purchase, extraordinary/special/exception procedures, and the above-licitación-menor threshold required by the canonical assertion.
Continuation completes the rule allowing direct purchases where nature/circumstance is incompatible with competition and supplies the cited RLGCP exception articles.

The pre-boundary portion already fully supports the initial post-opening transfer to US and its initial review to identify/request needed clarifications; the dangling 'Una vez que' begins a later proposition not needed by this fact.
Continuation states that after Proveeduría performs the clarification/subsanation step it transfers the offers again so US can issue the technical criterion.
Continuation expressly states the procedure is done this way because LGCP/RLGCP permit only one subsanation request procedure.
Continuation completes the collection method: charge against price retentions already made and outstanding payment balances.
Continuation supplies the integrated responsibility regimes and all named statutes/codes required by the canonical assertion.
The complete pre-boundary sentence assigns exclusive payment-processing responsibility to CCDRE under its own defined regulations; no continuation is needed.

dangling_referents.basis: Exact preceding evidence states the supplier obligation to verify/update registry information, including annual/update-on-change context, so 'esta disposición' resolves to that update duty.
Exact preceding evidence states that to execute fines/penalty clauses the Administration must issue a motivated act supported by evidence, so 'esa decisión' resolves to that decision/act.

All 24 page-adjacent targets were reclassified against source semantics: 12/12 REPAIR_REQUIRED rows now contain sufficient continuation evidence and 12/12 ALREADY_SUFFICIENT_BEFORE_BOUNDARY rows remain genuinely sufficient without continuation.
D3-F0098 includes the immediately preceding supplier-update duty resolving 'esta disposición'; D3-F0292 includes the immediately preceding motivated-act context resolving 'esa decisión'.

recommended_next_action: Governance/internal freeze. No further broad audit.
